title: inventory.v1.ReservationExpired
description: A reservation passed `expires_at` without being committed or released, and inventory reclaimed the units. Emitted by the expiry sweeper, not by a caller. This event exists because the alternative — reservations that leak when a saga dies — would slowly consume all stock. It is a safety net, and its firing during a healthy saga indicates the reservation TTL is set too short.

expired_at.description: When the reservation was reclaimed by the sweeper, which is at or after the expires_at it was given. The lag is the sweeper interval.

reserved_duration_ms.description: How long the claim was held before being reclaimed. Emitted so that reservation TTL tuning can be driven by measurement rather than guesswork.
